newsitem.title: GREECE: Chipita sees 15-20pct earnings growth in 97.
newsitem.headline: Chipita sees 15-20pct earnings growth in 97.

text.p: Croissant and snacks producer Chipita International forecast turnover and pretax profit growth of 15-20 percent in 1997, its management told the annual shareholders meeting.
Chipita will distribute a dividend per share of 130 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 87 drachmas in the previous year.
Its shares will trade ex-dividend in the first half of July 1997 and will simultaneously be split into two, halving their par value to 125 drachmas.
The company saw its 1996 pretax earnings nearly double to 1.8 billion drachmas from 910 million in 1995 on turnover growth of 52.4 percent to 21.8 billion drachmas.
Chipita's management told shareholders that a second production line for 'Bake-Rolls' would be operational in January 1998 to meet overwhelming demand in international markets.
The company has chosen to discontinue exports to other EU member states in order to satisfy demand in Germany and Italy which offer higher profit margins.
Recently, Chipita cut back on its exports to Italy, diverting all its foreign sales to Germany, management said.
Chipita's shares firmed 45 drachmas to 9,290 on Wednesday on volume of 26,170 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
